notes: Seed URL loads (CIRA page). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Results are scanned Electionware reports; the 2024 precinct report has an OCR text layer, the 2026 primary summary was read visually. Last-Modified differs per file (meaningful). Printed footer times run later than PDF creation and upload times (2024: printed 10:06 PM vs upload 9:42 PM), so the printing machine clock is not reliable. 2024 general had an unofficial precinct-by-precinct report on election night (END); in 2026 the county posted only a county summary (primary, 4:01 AM next morning) or nothing unofficial (runoff), with precinct numbers only in official canvass reports. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-2): 2026_runoff LATER to UNDETERMINED. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-4): 2026_primary LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-03-04 00:15 CT. Rule 47 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-47): none.
tag_rationale: Results: 2024_general END, 2026_primary LATER, 2026_runoff UNDETERMINED. No result is shared by two elections and more than one election is determined, so the rule gives UNKNOWN. (Recomputed under Rule 43, 2026-10-02.) Rule 47 checked 2026-10-02: no change.

2024_general.fact: 'LEON COUNTY UNOFFICIAL PRECINCT BY PRECINCT REPORT' (110524 UNOFFICIAL PCT BY PCT.pdf, 42 pages, OCR text): 'Summary Results Report UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 11/05/24 General Election w/BISD & OISD ... Pct #1 - Centerville ... TOTAL Absentee Early Voting Election Day ... Precinct Summary - 11/05/2024 10:06 PM'; per-precinct candidate votes including Election Day. PDF CreationDate Wed Nov 6 03:21:33 2024 UTC; Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 03:42:06 GMT (9:42 PM CST Nov 5). County summary 'UNOFFICIAL FINAL ALL PRECINCTS' Last-Modified 03:06:28 GMT (9:06 PM CST). One precinct report on election night, with the final unofficial count. Rule 47: publication shown by upload time 2024-11-05 21:42 CT in 110524 UNOFFICIAL PCT BY PCT.pdf.

2026_primary.fact: 'LEON COUNTY UNOFFICIAL TOTALS' (030326 JOINT PRIMARY UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 0001.pdf, scanned, read visually): 'Election Summary Results Report 2026 Primary Election March 3, 2026 ... UNOFFICIAL RESULTS Leon County, Texas ... Election Day Precincts Reporting 14 of 14'; county totals; footer 'Election Summary - 03/04/2026 12:15'. CreationDate Wed Mar 4 09:59:23 2026 UTC; Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 10:01:27 GMT (4:01 AM CST Mar 4). No unofficial precinct report listed; precinct numbers only in 'Official Canvass of Election Precinct by Precinct Results'. Rule 43: county totals first seen 2026-03-04 00:15 CT in 030326 JOINT PRIMARY UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 0001.pdf (printed footer 'Election Summary - 03/04/2026 12:15 PM'; the server received the scan at 04:01 AM CST Mar 4, so the printed 12:15 on Mar 4 can only be 12:15 AM; no unofficial precinct report listed).

2026_runoff.fact: Rule 43: no election-night file survives. Previous: Runoff results listed are only '05/26/26 Official Precinct Report-Group Detail' (file prefix 062226), '05/26/26 Canvass Totals for Joint Primary Run-Off Election', and a preliminary reconciliation; no unofficial or election-night results file is listed. Precinct numbers appear only in the official (canvass) report.
